purpose: Evaluate one analytic, fixed-k-normalized QUBO whose linear and quadratic coefficients directly approximate BEDROC20-style early ranking utility and receptor-pair complementarity.

evidence_timing.experiment_class: single prospectively frozen redesign after outcome-informed diagnosis

objective.rank_normalization: per-seed per-receptor empirical CDF fitted on outer-train rows only
objective.pair_complementarity: delta_ij=q_{ij}-max(q_i,q_j), where q_{ij} uses the better rank from receptor i or j
objective.fixed_k_qubo: Q_k(S)=mean_{i in S}(q_i)+mean_{i<j in S}(delta_ij); for k=1 the pair term is zero
objective.normalization_reason: separate normalization at each fixed k removes the Stage42d cardinality pressure and implements the previously proposed k=1..6 ladder
objective.qubo_form: For each frozen k, maximize sum_i(q_i/k)x_i + sum_{i<j}(delta_ij/C(k,2))x_i x_j subject to sum_i x_i=k.

screen.classical_search: beam-64, all singleton-start greedy paths, then deterministic fixed-k swap local search

support_gate.failure_action: Freeze this analytic redesign as unsupported and do not tune it on the same BACE1 outcomes.

interpretation_boundary: Stage42f is a train-only, outcome-informed BACE1 objective redesign evaluated with scaffold holdouts. A pass would authorize sparse fixed-k QUBO construction and one protected fresh-validation experiment, not quantum hardware or quantum advantage. A failure forbids further BACE1-specific tuning.
